title: Big Bang, Hubble Law and Expansion of the Universe

notes: **Big Bang theory:** the universe began about 13.8 billion years ago from an extremely hot, dense initial state and has been expanding ever since.
**Hubble's law:** $v = H_0 d$. The recessional velocity of a galaxy is proportional to its distance from us. $H_0 \approx 70\,\text{km/s/Mpc}$ is the Hubble constant.
**Redshift:** light from distant galaxies is shifted to longer wavelengths because the galaxies are moving away. This is the observational basis of Hubble's law.
**Cosmic microwave background (CMB):** the cooled remnant of the hot early universe, now at 2.7 K. Its discovery in 1965 was strong evidence for the Big Bang.
**Expansion implication:** if the universe is expanding now, it was smaller and denser in the past. Extrapolating back gives the initial singularity.
